senses.gloss:
स्वृ स्वृ, i. 1, Par.
 1. To sound.
 2. To praise (ved.).
 3. To be pained.
 4. † To go.
 --Caus. To sing, Chr. 294, 5 = Rigv. i. 88, 5 (सस्वर्, ved. aor.).
 --With सम् सम्, Ātm. To pain, Bhaṭṭ. 9, 28.
 --Cf. Lat. susurro, absurdus, surdus (properly, Suffering from humming in the ears), sorex; σύριγξ, ὕραξ, ὕρον; probably Goth. svaran; A.S. swaran, swerian, and-swar, answer; probably Lat. sorbere; ῥοϕέω (from the sound of drinking; cf. Zend. क़र् = Sskr. स्वर्, properly, To smack; cf. अव and वि, with स्वन्, also विष्वणन, विष्वाण).
† स्वॄ स्वॄ, स्वॄ स्बॄ, सॄ सॄ, ii. 9, स्वृणा, स्बृणा, सृणा, णी, Par. To hurt, to kill.
